jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Design Manager

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India

Experience: Minimum 15 years overall; 7+ years in leadership

Working Days- Monday-Saturday

Employment Type: Full-time

Role summary

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Design Manager with deep expertise in SolidWorks and Production line experience in Sheet Metal. You will lead design projects from concept through validation, mentor engineers, enforce design-for-manufacturability and cost‑efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in processes and tools. The role requires strong technical judgment, excellent stakeholder management, and hands-on involvement in complex sheet‑metal product development.

Key accountabilities-

- Team leadership and people management

 - Recruit, develop, retain, and scale a high-performing design team (mechanical engineers, CAD leads, drafters).
 - Establish clear role descriptions, career ladders, KPIs, and individual development plans.
 - Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, succession planning, and calibration with HR and senior leadership.
 - Promote a culture of ownership, continuous learning, safety, and cross-functional collaboration.

- Technical ownership and hands-on design

 - Provide hands-on SolidWorks leadership for complex sheet‑metal parts and assemblies; create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings.
 - Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries.
 - Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‑built documentation.

- Product development lifecycle & project leadership

 - Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full-scale production.
 - Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices).
 - Lead cross-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; present technical trade-offs and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders.

- Manufacturability, cost optimization & supplier engineering

 - Own DFMA for sheet‑metal: material selection, blank size optimization, bend allowances, nesting strategies, common parts, and fastener selection.
 - Collaborate with toolrooms and suppliers on tooling design (dies, progressive tooling, fixtures), vendor capabilities, and lead-time management.
 - Drive cost-down initiatives through design simplification, standardization, and volume-based sourcing strategies.

- Quality, compliance & reliability

 - Ensure designs meet applicable standards (safety, EMC, environmental) and internal quality requirements.
 - Lead root cause analysis (8D) for field failures involving mechanical design; drive corrective & preventive actions.
 - Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required.

- Process improvement & systems

 - Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management.
 - Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model-based definition (MBD) where applicable.
 - Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

- Stakeholder management & reporting

- Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements.
 - Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership.
 - Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings.

Deliverables & success metrics

- Deliverables

 - Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production.
 - DFMEA, tolerance stack-ups, verification & validation plans, prototype test reports.
 - Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials.

Required qualifications & experience (expanded)

- Education:
B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; M.Tech/M.S. preferred.
- Experience:
Minimum 15 years in mechanical/product design with heavy emphasis on sheet‑metal; at least 7 years in a managerial or lead capacity.
- CAD skills
: Expert-level SolidWorks (modeling, sheet‑metal module, assemblies, weldments, routing optional), experience with SolidWorks PDM/Manage or equivalent.
- Manufacturing knowledge:
Thorough understanding of sheet‑metal fabrication processes (laser, plasma, punching, bending, progressive forming), welding, adhesive joining, rivets, fastening, surface treatments, and finish processes.
- Systems:
Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM systems, ECO workflows, BOM management, and basic ERP interactions.
- Process skills
: DFMA, GD&T, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, root cause analysis tools (8D, RCA), and test plan development.
- Leadership:
Demonstrated people management, hiring, mentoring, and stakeholder negotiation experience.
- Communication
: Strong written and verbal English; ability to present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
- Mobility:
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and production sites (as required).

Preferred / differentiating skills

- Certifications:
CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent.
- Domain experience
: Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense.
- Simulation:
Experience with sheet‑metal forming simulation (e.g., AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization.
- Tooling & fixtures:
Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies.
- Software:
Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar.
- Manufacturing exposure:
Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We’re looking for a versatile and engaged Tech Director to join our Internal Game Development team and contribute to our goal of bringing best-in-class games to our members. The Tech Director will partner with cross-disciplinary teams to define and execute high-quality tech direction across a range of projects. This role requires a balance of technical leadership and hands-on implementation, with the ability to manage external partners, support multiple teams simultaneously, and establish scalable engineering practices that elevate the player experience across our games.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in Unreal Engine 5 or Unity, game systems, architecture, and cloud technologies, paired with a passion for innovation and player experience. You’ll operate as a key member of our studio leads group, partnering closely with the Game Director, Creative Director, Art Director, and Executive Producer to ensure seamless alignment between product, technology, and creative goals. You’ll set the bar for engineering excellence, drive integration with Netflix’s platform technologies, and champion a culture of experimentation, learning, and collaboration.

You’ll be joining an internal studio with big ambitions, and an obsession to create memorable game moments that leave players telling their own stories for years to come. We’re looking for new teammates who care deeply about the experiences they create and the people they make them with. Those who bias towards action and are energized by the learning that comes with bold experimentation at an agile pace. As a part of Netflix, we strive to hire the best and value integrity, excellence, respect, inclusion, and collaboration.

Responsibilities

Technology Visionary: Own all technical aspects of the project, from architecture and system design to development processes and technical documentation. Ensure the project’s technical direction is scalable, sustainable, and aligned with our creative vision.
Team Builder: Hire, mentor, and lead a world-class engineering team, cultivating an environment focused on innovation, growth, and exceptional development standards.
Execution Leader: Oversee technical execution across prototype, production, and live ops. Set and uphold the bar for code quality, performance, and reliability, and optimization.
Strategic Partner: Collaborate with studio leads to keep the project aligned with product strategy, and proactively drive course corrections when needed.

Expert in building and maintaining modular, scalable frameworks, with hands-on experience managing world partition, level streaming pipelines, asset virtualization, shader compilation, and build/cook systems.
Proven track record optimizing CPU, GPU, and memory footprints for constrained environments, as well as evaluating bandwidth and latency constraints to ensure performance and gameplay targets are met.
Deep technical expertise across game architecture, gameplay systems, content pipelines, artist workflows, rendering, backend services, and cross-platform development (including Linux).
Collaborates closely with art and design teams to balance visual fidelity and performance, and supports live service games through development, launch, and post-launch operations.
Familiar with contemporary web technologies (JavaScript, React, etc.) and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, etc.).
Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and scale multidisciplinary engineering teams, collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical leaders.
Exceptional communicator, skilled at building trust and alignment across teams and stakeholders.
Is self-motivated, curious, and eager to pitch in wherever needed, even outside their core responsibilities.
Thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments, navigating change with maturity, empathy, and a bias for action.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

Anduril’s Air Dominance and Strike (AD&S) Missions Systems team is seeking a Director to oversee seeker + sensing systems for Advanced Effects Mission Systems. The AD&S team is responsible for developing end-to-end “mission-ized” autonomous air systems capable of delivering exceptional warfighter outcomes to our customers.

As a Director, Mission Systems, Advanced Effects, you will be responsible for delivering mission outcomes within Anduril programs through the judicious selection, sourcing, and validation of mission relevant payloads and systems. The right person for this role will have experience in payload conceptual development, selection, integration, and validation. You will begin with mission-level outcomes and drive to solutions through appropriate modeling, domain expertise, and vendor engagement. This will require taking ownership of subcontractor and/or internal technical development efforts and working across various Anduril internal teams to appropriately integrate capabilities. If you are someone who enjoys building and delivering compelling next-generation autonomous capabilities through rigorous modeling and exploration of system trades followed by actual vehicle integration, then this role is for you. You will also develop an IRAD plan + creative scope for proposals and execution.

What You’ll Do

Conduct trades for communications, sensing, and effector systems to deliver successful mission outcomes working closely with the broader Advanced Effects team
Architect autonomous multi-function, multi-mode payload and system solution concepts, requirements, layout, interfaces, & employment
Adapt or derive physics-based models of payload system performance working closely with subject matter experts
Adapt or develop validated effects-based models for use in mission-level modeling & simulation tools
Validate system performance in close cooperation with test & integration engineers
Work closely with AD&S teams to successfully integrate & deliver high-performance systems to our customers
Manage subcontractors and/or internal development teams to define subsystem requirements and drive technical performance on schedule
Communicate results in multiple forms internally and externally

Required Qualifications

Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance
Communications, sensors, and effector domain expertise in one or more of Radar, EO/IR, RF, and EW systems
Physics-based modeling and analysis of system performance in tool(s) of your choice
5+ years in payload integration and validation. The more the better
10+ years in relevant Science and/or Engineering related field

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of current and next-generation advanced communications, sensing, and effector systems and platforms
Platform-level system trade and integration experience
Advanced proficiency in analytical toolchains or languages (e.g., MATLAB, Python, C++, COMSOL, Ansys)
Advanced communications experience (e.g., secure LPx line-of-sight, beyond line-of-sight, tactical data links)
Advanced sensing domain experience (e.g., EO/IR, ESM, EA, EW, LIDAR)
Experience with missile design & integration

$220,000—$292,000 USD
